audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows disagreed across layers. phases[].side read Cassiopeia/Cassiopeia/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Cassiopeia while content win[] and packet.levelChart read Skill/Skill/Skill/Cassiopeia/Lissandra/Cassiopeia/Lissandra.
audit.why: Early levels are a dodging contest (her 850 Q vs your 725 Q), 4-5 belong to her sustained Twin Fang plus Miasma zoning, 6 is yours because Frozen Tomb is point-and-click against a facing-dependent Petrifying Gaze, her first item swings back, and two items favour reliable lockdown against an immobile champion.
audit.corrected: All six sides realigned to the content/packet chart as one atomic group, with every why whose verdict flipped rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3] and phases[5] whys described Lissandra winning while the chart put those stages on Cassiopeia.
audit.why: Levels 4-5 are her Miasma-plus-Twin-Fang grind; her first item restores the kite that Frozen Tomb's 120s cannot cover.
audit.corrected: Both whys rewritten to name the mechanic that owns the stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] told the player to 'E through Miasma to close instantly'. Miasma grounds — Riot's text says grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities — so Lissandra's E is exactly the ability it denies.
audit.why: This is the single decisive interaction in the matchup and the page advised the reverse of it. dosFull[0].d and report[5].t stated the grounding correctly, so the page contradicted itself.
audit.corrected: The bullet now says to claw in before Miasma hits the ground, and the cooldowns field carries the 24s-to-16s window the claw has to live inside.
sources: enemyKit W text and grounding flag

audit.why: The whole matchup is a Miasma timer.
audit.corrected: Miasma 24s to 16s, Noxious Blast 3.5s, Twin Fang 0.75s, Frozen Tomb 120s stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds was mentioned only in report[8], never where a player plans a trade.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule needs-antiheal: Twin Fang heals for a percentage of damage dealt on a 0.75s cooldown, so extended trades are decided by anti-heal timing.
audit.corrected: breakdown.feeding now tells the player to buy Grievous Wounds early.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cassiopeia was called he/his in tldr, winCon, tradeGood, loading, phases[0].why, phases[3].why, breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].t and five report entries. dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim; dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists cassiopeia as female; the owner is addressed as 'you', so every third-person pronoun on the page is Cassiopeia.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in every full-layer field and in the two report entries the sweep allows; both bleed bullets rewritten to their own titles.
